recommendations.title: Index small-charity grants to inflation
recommendations.body: Index small-charity grants to inflation so funding values do not erode in real terms. Apply the index annually using the published CPI rate.

recommendations.title: Simplify the reporting burden for grants under £50k
recommendations.body: Simplify the reporting burden for grants under fifty thousand pounds. A short outcomes summary should suffice; replace line-by-line financial reporting with attestation.
